local L = require("lexer")
local D = {}
D.builtins = { __LINE__ = true, __FILE__ = true, __COUNTER__ = true }
local variadic_error = '"__VA_ARGS__" can only appear in the expansion of a variadic macro'
local function fail(message) error({ category = "definition", message = message }, 0) end
function D.check_name(tokens, directive)
    if #tokens == 0 then return "no macro name given in #" .. directive .. " directive" end
    if tokens[1].kind ~= "identifier" then return "macro names must be identifiers" end
    local name = tokens[1].spelling
    if name == "defined" then return '"defined" cannot be used as a macro name' end
    if D.builtins[name] then return "cannot " .. (directive == "define" and "redefine" or "undefine") .. ' builtin macro "' .. name .. '"' end
end
function D.signature(macro)
    if not macro.parameters then return macro.name end
    local parameters = { table.unpack(macro.parameters) }
    if macro.variadic then parameters[#parameters] = "..." end
    return macro.name .. "(" .. table.concat(parameters, ", ") .. ")"
end
function D.identical(a, b)
    if (not a.parameters) ~= (not b.parameters) or a.variadic ~= b.variadic then return false end
    if a.parameters then
        if #a.parameters ~= #b.parameters then return false end
        for i, name in ipairs(a.parameters) do if name ~= b.parameters[i] then return false end end
    end
    if #a.replacement ~= #b.replacement then return false end
    for i, token in ipairs(a.replacement) do
        if token.spelling ~= b.replacement[i].spelling or token.space ~= b.replacement[i].space then return false end
    end
    return true
end
function D.parse(tokens, position, main_file)
    local err = D.check_name(tokens, "define")
    if err then fail(err) end
    local name, parameters, variadic, index, parameter_set = tokens[1].spelling, false, false, 2, {}
    if name == "__VA_ARGS__" then fail(variadic_error) end
    if tokens[2] and tokens[2].spelling == "(" and not tokens[2].space then
        parameters, index = {}, 3
        if not tokens[index] then fail("missing ')' in macro parameter list") end
        if tokens[index].spelling == ")" then index = index + 1
        else
            while true do
                local token = tokens[index]
                if not token then fail("missing ')' in macro parameter list") end
                if token.spelling == "..." then parameters[#parameters + 1], variadic = "__VA_ARGS__", true
                elseif token.kind == "identifier" then
                    if token.spelling == "__VA_ARGS__" then fail(variadic_error) end
                    if parameter_set[token.spelling] then fail('duplicate macro parameter "' .. token.spelling .. '"') end
                    parameters[#parameters + 1] = token.spelling
                else fail('expected parameter name, found "' .. token.spelling .. '"') end
                parameter_set[parameters[#parameters]] = true
                index = index + 1
                if not tokens[index] then fail("missing ')' in macro parameter list") end
                local following = tokens[index].spelling
                index = index + 1
                if following == ")" then break end
                if variadic then fail('expected \')\' after "...", found "' .. following .. '"') end
                if following ~= "," then fail('expected \',\' or \')\', found "' .. following .. '"') end
            end
        end
    end
    local replacement = {}
    for i = index, #tokens do replacement[#replacement + 1] = L.clone(tokens[i]) end
    if #replacement > 0 then
        replacement[1].space = false
        if replacement[1].spelling == "##" or replacement[#replacement].spelling == "##" then fail("'##' cannot appear at either end of a macro expansion") end
    end
    for i, token in ipairs(replacement) do
        if token.kind == "identifier" and token.spelling == "__VA_ARGS__" and not variadic then fail(variadic_error) end
        local following = replacement[i + 1]
        if token.spelling == "#" and parameters and (not following or following.kind ~= "identifier" or not parameter_set[following.spelling]) then
            fail("'#' is not followed by a macro parameter")
        end
    end
    return { name = name, parameters = parameters, variadic = variadic, replacement = replacement,
        position = position, main_file = main_file, expanded = 0, tested = 0 }
end
return D

local L = require("lexer")
local D = require("definitions")
local X = {}
X.__index = X
local function union(a, b)
    local result = {}
    for name in pairs(a) do result[name] = true end
    for name in pairs(b) do result[name] = true end
    return result
end
local function intersection(a, b)
    local result = {}
    for name in pairs(a) do if b[name] then result[name] = true end end
    return result
end
function X.new(macros, diagnostic)
    return setmetatable({ macros = macros, diagnostic = diagnostic, counter = 0,
        builtin_counts = { __COUNTER__ = 0, __FILE__ = 0, __LINE__ = 0 } }, X)
end
function X:error(context, token, message) self.diagnostic(context:position(token.line), "error", message) end
function X:builtin(token, context)
    self.builtin_counts[token.spelling] = self.builtin_counts[token.spelling] + 1
    local kind, spelling = "number"
    if token.spelling == "__FILE__" then kind, spelling = "string", '"' .. context.display_file .. '"'
    elseif token.spelling == "__LINE__" then spelling = tostring(context:position(token.line)[2])
    else spelling, self.counter = tostring(self.counter), self.counter + 1 end
    return L.token(kind, spelling, token.line, token.space)
end
function X:collect(pending, head, tail, macro, token, context)
    local arguments, separators, nesting, closing, consumed = { {} }, {}, 0, false, false
    for i = head + 1, tail do
        local current = pending[i]
        if current.spelling == ")" and nesting == 0 then closing, consumed = current, i - head + 1; break end
        if current.spelling == "," and nesting == 0 then
            separators[#separators + 1], arguments[#arguments + 1] = current, {}
        else
            if current.spelling == "(" then nesting = nesting + 1 elseif current.spelling == ")" then nesting = nesting - 1 end
            local argument = arguments[#arguments]
            argument[#argument + 1] = current
        end
    end
    if not closing then self:error(context, token, 'unterminated argument list invoking macro "' .. macro.name .. '"'); return false end
    local count, fixed, err = #arguments, #macro.parameters - (macro.variadic and 1 or 0)
    if not macro.variadic and fixed == 0 and (count ~= 1 or #arguments[1] > 0) then
        err = string.format('macro "%s" passed %d arguments, but takes just 0', macro.name, count)
    elseif count < fixed then err = string.format('macro "%s" requires %d arguments, but only %d given', macro.name, fixed, count)
    elseif count > fixed and not macro.variadic then err = string.format('macro "%s" passed %d arguments, but takes just %d', macro.name, count, fixed) end
    if err then self:error(context, token, err); return false end
    local raw = {}
    for i = 1, fixed do raw[macro.parameters[i]] = arguments[i] end
    if macro.variadic then
        local variable = {}
        for i = fixed + 1, count do
            if i > fixed + 1 then variable[#variable + 1] = separators[i - 1] end
            for _, current in ipairs(arguments[i]) do variable[#variable + 1] = current end
        end
        raw.__VA_ARGS__ = variable
    end
    return raw, consumed, closing
end
function X:stringize(tokens, sharp)
    local pieces = {}
    for i, token in ipairs(tokens) do
        if i > 1 and token.space then pieces[#pieces + 1] = " " end
        local spelling = token.spelling
        if token.kind == "string" or token.kind == "character" then spelling = spelling:gsub("\\", "\\\\"):gsub('"', '\\"') end
        pieces[#pieces + 1] = spelling
    end
    return L.token("string", '"' .. table.concat(pieces) .. '"', sharp.line, sharp.space)
end
function X:paste(left, right, token, context)
    if left.kind == "placemarker" then return { L.clone(right, { space = left.space }) }
    elseif right.kind == "placemarker" then return { L.clone(left) } end
    local spelling = left.spelling .. right.spelling
    local kind = L.single_token(spelling)
    if kind then return { L.token(kind, spelling, left.line, left.space, intersection(left.hide, right.hide)) } end
    self:error(context, token, 'pasting "' .. left.spelling .. '" and "' .. right.spelling .. '" does not give a valid preprocessing token')
    return { L.clone(left), L.clone(right, { space = false }) }
end
function X:substitute(macro, raw, token, hide, context)
    local replacement, items, expanded, index = macro.replacement, {}, {}, 1
    while index <= #replacement do
        local current = replacement[index]
        if current.spelling == "#" and macro.parameters then
            items[#items + 1] = { self:stringize(raw[replacement[index + 1].spelling], current) }
            index = index + 2
        else
            if current.spelling == "##" then items[#items + 1] = { paste = true, token = current }
            elseif current.kind == "identifier" and raw[current.spelling] then
                local before, after = replacement[index - 1], replacement[index + 1]
                local adjacent = (before and before.spelling == "##") or (after and after.spelling == "##")
                local sequence
                if adjacent then sequence = raw[current.spelling]
                else
                    if not expanded[current.spelling] then expanded[current.spelling] = self:expand(raw[current.spelling], context) end
                    sequence = expanded[current.spelling]
                end
                local item = {}
                if #sequence > 0 then
                    for i, entry in ipairs(sequence) do item[i] = L.clone(entry) end
                    item[1].space = current.space
                else item[1] = L.token("placemarker", "", current.line, current.space) end
                items[#items + 1] = item
            else items[#items + 1] = { L.clone(current) } end
            index = index + 1
        end
    end
    local pasted = {}
    index = 1
    while index <= #items do
        local item = items[index]
        if item.paste then
            local left, right = table.remove(pasted), items[index + 1]
            if right.paste then right = { right.token } end
            for _, entry in ipairs(self:paste(left, right[1], token, context)) do pasted[#pasted + 1] = entry end
            for i = 2, #right do pasted[#pasted + 1] = L.clone(right[i]) end
            index = index + 2
        else
            for _, entry in ipairs(item) do pasted[#pasted + 1] = entry end
            index = index + 1
        end
    end
    local result, carry = {}, false
    for _, current in ipairs(pasted) do
        if current.kind == "placemarker" then carry = carry or current.space
        else
            result[#result + 1] = L.clone(current, { line = token.line, space = current.space or carry, hide = union(current.hide, hide) })
            carry = false
        end
    end
    if #result > 0 then result[1].space = token.space end
    return result
end
function X:expand(sequence, context)
    local pending, head, tail, result = {}, 1, #sequence, {}
    for i, token in ipairs(sequence) do pending[i] = L.clone(token) end
    while head <= tail do
        local token = pending[head]
        pending[head], head = nil, head + 1
        local macro = self.macros[token.spelling]
        if token.kind ~= "identifier" or token.hide[token.spelling] then result[#result + 1] = token
        elseif D.builtins[token.spelling] then result[#result + 1] = self:builtin(token, context)
        elseif not macro or (macro.parameters and (head > tail or pending[head].spelling ~= "(")) then result[#result + 1] = token
        else
            local raw, hide = {}, union(token.hide, { [macro.name] = true })
            if macro.parameters then
                local consumed, closing
                raw, consumed, closing = self:collect(pending, head, tail, macro, token, context)
                if raw then
                    for _ = 1, consumed do pending[head], head = nil, head + 1 end
                    hide = union(intersection(token.hide, closing.hide), { [macro.name] = true })
                end
            end
            if not raw then result[#result + 1] = token
            else
                local produced = self:substitute(macro, raw, token, hide, context)
                macro.expanded = macro.expanded + 1
                if #produced == 0 and token.space and head <= tail then pending[head] = L.clone(pending[head], { space = true }) end
                for i = #produced, 1, -1 do head = head - 1; pending[head] = produced[i] end
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end
return X

local E = {}
local levels = { { ["||"] = true }, { ["&&"] = true }, { ["|"] = true }, { ["^"] = true }, { ["&"] = true },
    { ["=="] = true, ["!="] = true }, { ["<"] = true, [">"] = true, ["<="] = true, [">="] = true },
    { ["<<"] = true, [">>"] = true }, { ["+"] = true, ["-"] = true }, { ["*"] = true, ["/"] = true, ["%"] = true } }
local function fail(message) error({ category = "expression", message = message }, 0) end
local function integer(spelling)
    local value = spelling
    for _, suffix in ipairs({ "ll", "LL", "l", "L" }) do
        if #value > #suffix and value:sub(-#suffix) == suffix then value = value:sub(1, #value - #suffix); break end
    end
    local base, digits
    if value:match("^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+$") then base, digits = 16, value:sub(3)
    elseif value:match("^0[0-7]*$") then base, digits = 8, value
    elseif value:match("^[1-9][0-9]*$") then base, digits = 10, value
    else fail('invalid integer constant "' .. spelling .. '"') end
    local result = 0
    for i = 1, #digits do
        local code = digits:byte(i)
        local digit = code <= 57 and code - 48 or (code <= 70 and code - 55 or code - 87)
        result = result * base + digit
    end
    return result
end
local function character(spelling)
    local value = spelling:sub(2, -2)
    if #value == 1 and value ~= "'" and value ~= "\\" then return value:byte() end
    local escapes = { n = 10, t = 9, ["\\"] = 92, ["'"] = 39, ['"'] = 34, ["0"] = 0 }
    if #value == 2 and value:sub(1, 1) == "\\" and escapes[value:sub(2)] ~= nil then return escapes[value:sub(2)] end
    fail("invalid character constant " .. spelling)
end
local P = {}
P.__index = P
function P:peek() return self.tokens[self.position] and self.tokens[self.position].spelling or false end
function P:expression()
    local left = self:binary(1)
    if self:peek() == "?" then
        self.position = self.position + 1
        local first = self:expression()
        if self:peek() ~= ":" then fail("'?' without following ':'") end
        self.position = self.position + 1
        left = { "conditional", left, first, self:expression() }
    end
    return left
end
function P:binary(level)
    if level == 11 then return self:unary() end
    local left = self:binary(level + 1)
    while levels[level][self:peek()] do
        local operator = self:peek()
        self.position = self.position + 1
        left = { "binary", operator, left, self:binary(level + 1) }
    end
    return left
end
function P:unary()
    local spelling = self:peek()
    if spelling == "+" or spelling == "-" or spelling == "!" or spelling == "~" then
        self.position = self.position + 1
        return { "unary", spelling, self:unary() }
    end
    local token = self.tokens[self.position]
    if not token then fail("expected value at end of expression") end
    self.position = self.position + 1
    if token.kind == "number" then return { "constant", integer(token.spelling) }
    elseif token.kind == "character" then return { "constant", character(token.spelling) }
    elseif token.kind == "identifier" then return { "identifier", token.spelling }
    elseif token.spelling == "(" then
        local value = self:expression()
        if self:peek() ~= ")" then fail("missing ')' in expression") end
        self.position = self.position + 1
        return value
    end
    fail('expected value before "' .. token.spelling .. '"')
end
function E.parse(tokens, directive)
    if #tokens == 0 then fail("#" .. directive .. " with no expression") end
    local parser = setmetatable({ tokens = tokens, position = 1 }, P)
    local tree = parser:expression()
    if parser:peek() then fail('missing binary operator before "' .. parser:peek() .. '"') end
    return tree
end
local function binary(operator, a, b)
    if operator == "/" or operator == "%" then
        if b == 0 then fail("division by zero in #if") end
        local quotient = math.abs(a) // math.abs(b)
        if (a < 0) ~= (b < 0) then quotient = -quotient end
        return operator == "/" and quotient or a - b * quotient
    elseif operator == "+" then return a + b elseif operator == "-" then return a - b
    elseif operator == "*" then return a * b elseif operator == "<<" then return a * (1 << b)
    elseif operator == ">>" then return a // (1 << b) elseif operator == "&" then return a & b
    elseif operator == "|" then return a | b elseif operator == "^" then return a ~ b
    elseif operator == "==" then return a == b and 1 or 0 elseif operator == "!=" then return a ~= b and 1 or 0
    elseif operator == "<" then return a < b and 1 or 0 elseif operator == ">" then return a > b and 1 or 0
    elseif operator == "<=" then return a <= b and 1 or 0 end
    return a >= b and 1 or 0
end
function E.evaluate(tree, warning)
    local pending, values = { { "evaluate", tree } }, {}
    while #pending > 0 do
        local command = table.remove(pending)
        local operation, item = command[1], command[2]
        if operation == "evaluate" then
            local kind = item[1]
            if kind == "constant" then values[#values + 1] = item[2]
            elseif kind == "identifier" then warning('identifier "' .. item[2] .. '" evaluates to 0'); values[#values + 1] = 0
            elseif kind == "unary" then pending[#pending + 1], pending[#pending + 2] = { "unary", item[2] }, { "evaluate", item[3] }
            elseif kind == "conditional" then pending[#pending + 1], pending[#pending + 2] = { "choose", { item[3], item[4] } }, { "evaluate", item[2] }
            elseif item[2] == "&&" or item[2] == "||" then
                pending[#pending + 1], pending[#pending + 2] = { "logical", { item[2], item[4] } }, { "evaluate", item[3] }
            else
                pending[#pending + 1], pending[#pending + 2], pending[#pending + 3] = { "binary", item[2] }, { "evaluate", item[4] }, { "evaluate", item[3] }
            end
        elseif operation == "choose" then pending[#pending + 1] = { "evaluate", table.remove(values) ~= 0 and item[1] or item[2] }
        elseif operation == "logical" then
            local first = table.remove(values)
            if (item[1] == "&&" and first == 0) or (item[1] == "||" and first ~= 0) then values[#values + 1] = first ~= 0 and 1 or 0
            else pending[#pending + 1], pending[#pending + 2] = { "truth" }, { "evaluate", item[2] } end
        elseif operation == "truth" then values[#values + 1] = table.remove(values) ~= 0 and 1 or 0
        elseif operation == "unary" then
            local value = table.remove(values)
            if item == "+" then values[#values + 1] = value elseif item == "-" then values[#values + 1] = -value
            elseif item == "!" then values[#values + 1] = value == 0 and 1 or 0 else values[#values + 1] = -value - 1 end
        else
            local b, a = table.remove(values), table.remove(values)
            values[#values + 1] = binary(item, a, b)
        end
    end
    return values[1]
end
return E

local L = require("lexer")
local M = {}
M.__index = M
M.starts = { ["if"] = true, ifdef = true, ifndef = true }
M.branches = { ["else"] = true, elif = true, elifdef = true, elifndef = true }
function M.directive_name(tokens)
    if #tokens >= 2 and tokens[1].spelling == "#" and tokens[2].kind == "identifier" then return tokens[2].spelling end
    return false
end
local function guard(lines)
    local nonempty = {}
    for _, line in ipairs(lines) do if #line.tokens > 0 then nonempty[#nonempty + 1] = line.tokens end end
    if #nonempty == 0 then return false end
    local first, last = nonempty[1], nonempty[#nonempty]
    if #first ~= 3 or M.directive_name(first) ~= "ifndef" or first[3].kind ~= "identifier" then return false end
    if #last ~= 2 or M.directive_name(last) ~= "endif" then return false end
    local depth = 0
    for i, tokens in ipairs(nonempty) do
        local name = M.directive_name(tokens)
        if M.branches[name] and depth == 1 then return false end
        if M.starts[name] then depth = depth + 1 elseif name == "endif" then depth = depth - 1 end
        if depth == 0 and i ~= #nonempty then return false end
    end
    return depth == 0 and first[3].spelling or false
end
function M.new() return setmetatable({ files = {}, order = {} }, M) end
function M:search(name, quoted)
    local paths = quoted and { name, "include/" .. name } or { "include/" .. name }
    for _, path in ipairs(paths) do
        local file = io.open("input/" .. path, "r")
        if file then file:close(); return path end
    end
    return false
end
function M:load(path)
    if not self.files[path] then
        local file = assert(io.open("input/" .. path, "r"))
        local contents = file:read("*a")
        file:close()
        local lines = L.source(contents)
        local _, count = contents:gsub("\n", "")
        self.files[path] = { path = path, physical_lines = count, lines = lines, guard = guard(lines),
            once = false, entered = 0, skipped = 0, output_lines = 0, skipped_lines = 0 }
        self.order[#self.order + 1] = path
    end
    return self.files[path]
end
return M

local L = {}
local punctuators = { "...", "<<=", ">>=", "->", "++", "--", "<<", ">>", "<=", ">=", "==", "!=", "&&", "||",
    "*=", "/=", "%=", "+=", "-=", "&=", "^=", "|=", "##", "[", "]", "(", ")", "{", "}", ".", "&", "*", "+", "-",
    "~", "!", "/", "%", "<", ">", "^", "|", "?", ":", ";", "=", ",", "#" }
function L.token(kind, spelling, line, space, hide)
    return { kind = kind, spelling = spelling, line = line, space = space, hide = hide or {} }
end
function L.clone(token, changes)
    local result = L.token(token.kind, token.spelling, token.line, token.space, token.hide)
    if changes then for key, value in pairs(changes) do result[key] = value end end
    return result
end
function L.read_token(text, position, header)
    position = position or 1
    local ch, ending = text:sub(position, position), position + 1
    if header and ch == "<" then
        local close, newline = text:find(">", ending, true), text:find("\n", ending, true)
        if close and (not newline or close < newline) then return "header", text:sub(position, close), close + 1 end
    end
    if ch:match("[A-Za-z_]") then
        local spelling = text:sub(position):match("^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*")
        return "identifier", spelling, position + #spelling
    elseif ch:match("[0-9]") or (ch == "." and text:sub(ending, ending):match("[0-9]")) then
        while ending <= #text do
            local current, following = text:sub(ending, ending), text:sub(ending + 1, ending + 1)
            if current:match("[eEpP]") and (following == "+" or following == "-") then ending = ending + 2
            elseif current:match("[A-Za-z_0-9.]") then ending = ending + 1
            else break end
        end
        return "number", text:sub(position, ending - 1), ending
    elseif ch == '"' or ch == "'" then
        while ending <= #text and text:sub(ending, ending) ~= "\n" do
            local current = text:sub(ending, ending)
            if current == ch then return ch == '"' and "string" or "character", text:sub(position, ending), ending + 1 end
            if current == "\\" and ending < #text and text:sub(ending + 1, ending + 1) ~= "\n" then ending = ending + 2
            else ending = ending + 1 end
        end
    end
    for _, punctuator in ipairs(punctuators) do
        if text:sub(position, position + #punctuator - 1) == punctuator then return "punctuator", punctuator, position + #punctuator end
    end
    return "other", ch, position + 1
end
local function scan(text, positions, start)
    local lines, tokens, index, spaced = {}, {}, 1, true
    start = start or 1
    while index <= #text do
        local ch, pair = text:sub(index, index), text:sub(index, index + 1)
        if ch == " " then spaced, index = true, index + 1
        elseif ch == "\n" then
            local ending = positions[index]
            lines[#lines + 1] = { tokens = tokens, start = start, ending = ending }
            tokens, start, spaced, index = {}, ending + 1, true, index + 1
        elseif pair == "/*" then
            local close = text:find("*/", index + 2, true)
            index, spaced = close and close + 2 or #text + 1, true
        elseif pair == "//" then index, spaced = text:find("\n", index + 2, true) or #text + 1, true
        else
            local header = #tokens == 2 and tokens[1].spelling == "#" and tokens[2].spelling == "include"
            local kind, spelling, ending = L.read_token(text, index, header)
            tokens[#tokens + 1] = L.token(kind, spelling, positions[index], spaced)
            index, spaced = ending, false
        end
    end
    if #tokens > 0 then lines[#lines + 1] = { tokens = tokens, start = start, ending = positions[#positions] } end
    return lines
end
function L.source(text)
    local characters, positions, index, line = {}, {}, 1, 1
    while index <= #text do
        if text:sub(index, index + 1) == "\\\n" then index, line = index + 2, line + 1
        else
            local ch = text:sub(index, index)
            characters[#characters + 1], positions[#positions + 1] = ch, line
            if ch == "\n" then line = line + 1 end
            index = index + 1
        end
    end

local I = {}
I.__index = I
function I:position(physical) return { self.display_file, physical + self.offset } end
function I:skipping() return #self.stack > 0 and not self.stack[#self.stack].active end

function P.new()

        diagnostic_counts = { error = 0, warning = 0 },
        condition_counts = { taken = 0, not_taken = 0, skipped = 0, not_evaluated = 0, endif = 0 } }, P)

function P:diagnostic(position, kind, message)

function P:event(position, content) self.history[#self.history + 1] = string.format("%s:%d: %s", position[1], position[2], content) end

function P:unused_check(macro)

function P:define(tokens, position, main_file)

        self:diagnostic(position, "error", macro.message)

    end

    if not previous then

end
function P:process_defines()

        number = number + 1
        if line ~= "" then
            local at = line:find("=", 1, true)
            local text = at and line:sub(1, at - 1) .. " " .. line:sub(at + 1) or line .. " 1"

function P:marker(filename, line, flag)

        for _ = 1, line - self.previous[2] - 1 do self.output[#self.output + 1] = "" end

    local index = 1
    while index <= #expanded do
        local last, physical = index, expanded[index].line
        while expanded[last + 1] and expanded[last + 1].line == physical do last = last + 1 end

function P:macro_defined(name)

function P:replace_operators(context, operands)
    local replaced, position = {}, 1
    while position <= #operands do
        local token, index, value = operands[position]
        if token.kind == "identifier" and token.spelling == "defined" then
            index = position + 1
            local parenthesized = operands[index] and operands[index].spelling == "("
            if parenthesized then index = index + 1 end
            if not operands[index] or operands[index].kind ~= "identifier" then fail('operator "defined" requires an identifier') end
            local name = operands[index].spelling
            index = index + 1
            if parenthesized then
                if not operands[index] or operands[index].spelling ~= ")" then fail('missing \')\' after "defined"') end
                index = index + 1

        elseif token.kind == "identifier" and token.spelling == "__has_include" then

            if not header or header.name == "" then fail('operator "__has_include" requires a header-name') end

function P:test(context, logical, name, operands)
    local position = context:position(logical.tokens[1].line)
    self:poison_check(context, operands)

        if #operands == 0 then self:diagnostic(position, "error", "no macro name given in #" .. name .. " directive"); return nil, false end
        if operands[1].kind ~= "identifier" then self:diagnostic(position, "error", "macro names must be identifiers"); return nil, false end
        if #operands >= 2 then self:diagnostic(position, "warning", "extra tokens at end of #" .. name .. " directive") end
        local defined = self:macro_defined(operands[1].spelling)
        if name == "ifndef" or name == "elifndef" then defined = not defined end
        return defined and 1 or 0, false
    end
    local ok, replaced = pcall(self.replace_operators, self, context, operands)
    if not ok then
        if type(replaced) ~= "table" or replaced.category ~= "directive" then error(replaced) end
        self:diagnostic(position, "error", replaced.message)
        return nil, false
    end
    local expanded = self.expander:expand(replaced, context)
    local value
    ok, value = pcall(function()
        local tree = Expression.parse(expanded, name)
        return Expression.evaluate(tree, function(message) self:diagnostic(position, "warning", message) end)
    end)
    if not ok then
        if type(value) ~= "table" or value.category ~= "expression" then error(value) end
        self:diagnostic(position, "error", value.message)
        return nil, expanded
    end
    return value, expanded
end
local function test_description(name, value, expanded)
    local description
    if value == nil then description = "not taken (error)"
    else
        description = value ~= 0 and "taken" or "not taken"
        if name == "if" or name == "elif" then description = description .. " (value " .. value .. ")" end
    end
    if expanded then description = description .. " [" .. output_render(expanded) .. "]" end

end
function P:close_region(context, block, ending)

        self.regions[#self.regions + 1] = string.format("%s:%d-%d lines=%d", first[1], first[2], last[2], ending - start + 1)
        context.source.skipped_lines = context.source.skipped_lines + ending - start + 1

end

    self.conditional_records[#self.conditional_records + 1] = string.format("%s:%d: %s%s => %s", position[1], position[2], string.rep("  ", depth), directive, description)
    for _, entry in ipairs({ { "taken", "taken" }, { "not taken", "not_taken" }, { "skipped", "skipped" },
        { "not evaluated", "not_evaluated" }, { "closes", "endif" } }) do

function P:conditional(context, logical, name, operands)

            local value, expanded = self:test(context, logical, name, operands)
            if value ~= nil and value ~= 0 then block.chosen, block.active = true, true
            else block.skip_start = logical.ending + 1 end
            description = test_description(name, value, expanded)
        else description = "skipped" end

    if #context.stack == 0 then self:diagnostic(position, "error", "#" .. name .. " without #if"); return end

        elseif block.chosen then block.active, description = false, "not evaluated"
        else
            local value, expanded = self:test(context, logical, name, operands)
            block.active = value ~= nil and value ~= 0
            if block.active then block.chosen = true end
            description = test_description(name, value, expanded)
        end

function P:include(context, logical, operands)
    local position, header = context:position(logical.tokens[1].line)
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        local sequence, consumed = operands
        header, consumed = header_specification(sequence)
        if not header and #sequence > 0 then
            sequence = self.expander:expand(sequence, context)
            header, consumed = header_specification(sequence)
        end
        if not header then fail('#include expects "FILENAME" or <FILENAME>') end
        if consumed <= #sequence then self:diagnostic(position, "warning", "extra tokens at end of #include directive") end
        if header.name == "" then fail("empty filename in #include") end
    end)
    if not ok then
        if type(err) ~= "table" or err.category ~= "directive" then error(err) end
        self:diagnostic(position, "error", err.message)
        return
    end
    local prefix = string.rep("  ", context.depth + 1) .. logical.tokens[1].line .. ": "
    local path = self.manager:search(header.name, header.quoted)
    if not path then
        self.tree[#self.tree + 1] = prefix .. header.rendering .. " [not found]"
        self:diagnostic(position, "error", "cannot find include file " .. header.rendering)
        return
    end
    local previous = self.manager.files[path]
    if previous and previous.once then
        self.tree[#self.tree + 1] = prefix .. path .. " [skipped: pragma once]"
        previous.skipped = previous.skipped + 1
        return
    elseif previous and previous.guard and self.macros[previous.guard] then
        self.tree[#self.tree + 1] = prefix .. path .. " [skipped: guard " .. previous.guard .. "]"
        previous.skipped = previous.skipped + 1
        return
    elseif context.depth + 1 > 8 then
        self.tree[#self.tree + 1] = prefix .. path .. " [too deep]"
        self:diagnostic(position, "error", "#include nested too deeply")
        return
    end
    self.tree[#self.tree + 1] = prefix .. path
    self:marker(path, 1, 1)
    self:process_file(path, context.depth + 1)
    local returning = context:position(logical.ending + 1)

function P:line_directive(context, logical, operands)
    local position = context:position(logical.tokens[1].line)
    if #operands == 0 or not decimal_token(operands[1]) then operands = self.expander:expand(operands, context) end
    if (#operands ~= 1 and #operands ~= 2) or not decimal_token(operands[1]) or (#operands == 2 and operands[2].kind ~= "string") then
        self:diagnostic(position, "error", "invalid #line directive")
        return
    end
    local line = tonumber(operands[1].spelling)
    if line < 1 or line > 2147483647 then self:diagnostic(position, "error", "line number out of range"); return end

function P:macro_pragma(position, operands, operation)

        self:diagnostic(position, "error", "invalid #pragma " .. operation .. " directive")
        return
    end

    self.saved[name] = self.saved[name] or {}
    local stack = self.saved[name]
    if operation == "push_macro" then
        stack[#stack + 1] = self.macros[name] or false
        self:event(position, "push " .. name)
    elseif #stack == 0 then self:diagnostic(position, "warning", 'no matching push_macro for "' .. name .. '"')
    else
        local macro = table.remove(stack)
        if not macro then self.macros[name] = nil; self:event(position, "pop " .. name .. " (undefined)")

        if #operands >= 2 then self:diagnostic(position, "warning", "extra tokens at end of #pragma once directive") end

    elseif #operands >= 2 and operands[1].spelling == "GCC" and operands[2].spelling == "poison" then
        for i = 3, #operands do
            if operands[i].kind ~= "identifier" then self:diagnostic(position, "error", "invalid #pragma GCC poison directive"); return end
        end
        for i = 3, #operands do
            local token = operands[i]
            if self.macros[token.spelling] then self:diagnostic(position, "warning", 'poisoning existing macro "' .. token.spelling .. '"') end
            self.poisoned[token.spelling] = true
        end
    elseif name == "push_macro" or name == "pop_macro" then self:macro_pragma(position, operands, name)

function P:directive(context, logical, name, operands)
    if #logical.tokens == 1 then return end

    if not poisoning then self:poison_check(context, operands) end
    local position = context:position(logical.tokens[1].line)
    if name == "define" then self:define(operands, position, context.depth == 0)
    elseif name == "undef" then self:undefine(operands, position)
    elseif name == "include" then self:include(context, logical, operands)
    elseif name == "line" then self:line_directive(context, logical, operands)
    elseif name == "error" or name == "warning" then
        self:diagnostic(position, name, "#" .. name .. (#operands > 0 and " " .. L.render(operands) or ""))

function P:process_file(path, depth)

    for _, logical in ipairs(source.lines) do
        local tokens = logical.tokens
        local is_directive = #tokens > 0 and tokens[1].spelling == "#"
        local name, operands = Manager.directive_name(tokens), slice(tokens, 3)
        if is_directive and (Manager.starts[name] or Manager.branches[name] or name == "endif") then
            self:flush(context)
            self:conditional(context, logical, name, operands)
        elseif context:skipping() then
        elseif is_directive then
            self:flush(context)
            self:directive(context, logical, name, operands)
        else append(context.segment, tokens) end
    end
    self:flush(context)
    for _, block in ipairs(context.stack) do self:close_region(context, block, source.physical_lines) end

function P:include_report()

    append(lines, { "", "== files ==" })
    for _, path in ipairs(keys(self.manager.files)) do
        local source = self.manager.files[path]
        lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("%s entered=%d skipped=%d lines=%d output_lines=%d skipped_lines=%d guard=%s once=%s",
            path, source.entered, source.skipped, source.physical_lines, source.output_lines, source.skipped_lines,
            source.guard or "-", source.once and "yes" or "no")
    end
    lines[#lines + 1] = ""
    local current, has_path = "main.o:", false
    for _, path in ipairs(self.manager.order) do
        if #current + 1 + #path > 76 and has_path then
            lines[#lines + 1] = current .. " \\"
            current, has_path = " ", false
        end
        current, has_path = current .. " " .. path, true
    end
    lines[#lines + 1] = current
    return lines
end
function P:references()
    local references = {}
    for name, macro in pairs(self.macros) do
        local parameters, found = {}, {}
        for _, parameter in ipairs(macro.parameters or {}) do parameters[parameter] = true end
        for _, token in ipairs(macro.replacement) do
            if token.kind == "identifier" and self.macros[token.spelling] and not parameters[token.spelling] then found[token.spelling] = true end
        end
        references[name] = keys(found)
    end

end
local function recursive(name, references)
    local pending, seen = { table.unpack(references[name]) }, {}
    while #pending > 0 do
        local current = table.remove(pending)
        if current == name then return true end
        if not seen[current] then seen[current] = true; append(pending, references[current]) end
    end
    return false
end
function P:macro_report()

    append(lines, { "", "== table ==" })
    local references, names, object_like = self:references(), keys(self.macros), 0
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        local macro = self.macros[name]
        local definition = "#define " .. D.signature(macro)
        if #macro.replacement > 0 then definition = definition .. " " .. L.render(macro.replacement) end
        lines[#lines + 1] = definition
        lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("  at %s:%d expanded=%d tested=%d recursive=%s", macro.position[1], macro.position[2],
            macro.expanded, macro.tested, recursive(name, references) and "yes" or "no")

        if not macro.parameters then object_like = object_like + 1 end
    end
    append(lines, { "", string.format("macros=%d object_like=%d function_like=%d", #names, object_like, #names - object_like) })

    for _, name in ipairs(keys(self.ever_defined)) do if not self.macros[name] then undefined[#undefined + 1] = name end end
    lines[#lines + 1] = following("undefined:", undefined)
    local counts = self.expander.builtin_counts
    lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("builtins: __COUNTER__=%d __FILE__=%d __LINE__=%d", counts.__COUNTER__, counts.__FILE__, counts.__LINE__)

end
function P:conditional_report()
    local lines = { table.unpack(self.conditional_records) }
    append(lines, { "", "== skipped regions ==" })
    append(lines, self.regions)
    lines[#lines + 1] = ""
    local counts = self.condition_counts
    lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("directives=%d taken=%d not_taken=%d skipped=%d not_evaluated=%d endif=%d regions=%d",
        #self.conditional_records, counts.taken, counts.not_taken, counts.skipped, counts.not_evaluated, counts.endif, #self.regions)
    return lines
end
function P:write_reports()
    local diagnostics = { table.unpack(self.diagnostics) }
    diagnostics[#diagnostics + 1] = string.format("errors=%d warnings=%d", self.diagnostic_counts.error, self.diagnostic_counts.warning)
    for _, entry in ipairs({ { "preprocessed.txt", self.output }, { "includes.txt", self:include_report() },
        { "macros.txt", self:macro_report() }, { "conditionals.txt", self:conditional_report() }, { "diagnostics.txt", diagnostics } }) do
        local output = assert(io.open("output/" .. entry[1], "w"))
        for _, line in ipairs(entry[2]) do output:write((line:gsub(" +$", "")), "\n") end
        output:close()
    end
end
local preprocessor = P.new()
preprocessor:process_defines()
preprocessor:marker("main.c", 1)
preprocessor:process_file("main.c", 0)
for _, name in ipairs(keys(preprocessor.macros)) do preprocessor:unused_check(preprocessor.macros[name]) end
preprocessor:write_reports()
